map.秸秆还田量优化器 使用指南: Straw Return Amount Optimizer User Guide
map.秸秆还田优化器，基于碳氮比平衡计算最佳还田量与补氮量，避免还田后缺氮影响作物生长: The straw return optimizer computes the optimal return amount and supplemental nitrogen from the C/N balance, avoiding nitrogen shortage that would hurt crop growth.
map.秸秆 C/N = 碳% ÷ 氮%；目标总氮 = 总碳 ÷ 目标C/N；补氮量 =: Straw C/N = carbon% ÷ nitrogen%; target total nitrogen = total carbon ÷ target C/N; nitrogen to add = max(0, target total nitrogen − straw nitrogen); fertilizer amount = nitrogen to add ÷ fertilizer nitrogen%
map.秸秆还田后微生物分解会与作物争氮，故需按目标碳氮比补氮。总碳 = 还田量 × 碳: After straw is returned, decomposing microbes compete with the crop for nitrogen, so nitrogen must be added to reach the target C/N. Total carbon = return amount × carbon content%, and the target total nitrogen brings it to the chosen C/N (25 is common); the shortfall divided by the selected fertilizer's nitrogen content gives the fertilizer to add. The tool also suggests the best return amount from the soil organic matter (more on poor soil, less when already rich) and estimates the decomposition days.
map.还田量 = 秸秆产量 × 还田比例，折算还田养分。: Return amount = straw yield × return ratio, converted into returned nutrients.
map.按土壤承载力与下茬播种可行性定比例。: Set the ratio by soil carrying capacity and whether the next crop can still be sown.
map.用于培肥与碳循环核算。: For soil fertility and carbon cycle accounting.
map.：亩产秸秆 800 kg（干），还田比例 80%，则还田 640 kg/亩，约带: : with a straw yield of 800 kg dry per mu and an 80% return ratio, 640 kg/mu goes back, bringing in about 540 kg organic matter, 4.8 kg N, 1.6 kg P₂O₅, and 6.4 kg K₂O. That partly replaces fertilizer, but nitrogen fertilizer is still needed to balance the C/N ratio.

map.秸秆还田为什么要配氮肥？: Why Apply Nitrogen Fertilizer When Returning Straw?
map.秸秆碳氮比高（约 60~80:1），微生物分解争氮导致『与苗争氮』黄苗。还田时补: Straw has a high C/N ratio (about 60–80:1), so microbes competing for nitrogen during decomposition cause nitrogen competition and yellowing seedlings. Applying a small amount of quick-release nitrogen at return (say 5 kg/mu of urea) eases it.
map.还田比例越高越好吗？: Is a Higher Return Ratio Always Better?
map.过高影响播种质量、地温与出苗，尤其冷凉区。一般 50%~80% 为宜，剩余离田能: Too high a rate hurts sowing quality, soil temperature, and emergence, especially in cool regions. Generally 50%–80% works, with the rest taken off the field for energy or feed so soil improvement and farm work stay balanced.
